_readme: First and last train, if you have the real figures. Shipped empty on purpose.
LTA publishes no train timetable through DataMall, and there is no network-wide last
train: first trains leave termini around 05:00-05:30 and last trains around 23:15-00:15,
varying by line AND by direction - the last train one way can go nearly an hour before
the last train the other way. Two GTFS feeds on GitHub claim Singapore train schedules;
both say in their own READMEs that the MRT timings are synthetic. They are not used.
With this file empty the app treats 05:00-00:15 as an outer envelope - outside it nothing
runs anywhere, so no rail option is offered - and between 23:15 and 00:15 it adds a
caution to rail options instead of promising a train that may already have gone.
Fill in 'default' and/or 'lines' from the operator's published times (SMRT Connect, SBS
Transit, or the first/last train poster at the station) and the app uses them instead,
dropping the caution because it no longer has to guess.
Line codes are the app's canonical ones - see backend/linecodes.py. Times are HH:MM, and
a last train after midnight may be written either 00:15 or 24:15.
Not modelled: direction. These are per line, so a line is treated as running until its
latest last train in either direction.
